method: Built-in image_gen; original Japanese transparent name sprites used as references

images.name: Belfrau
images.prompt: Edit target: the attached original Summon Night 3 PSP name lettering sprite. Replace ALL Japanese letters with the exact English name "Belfrau". Output only this single word, no other text. Keep the bold, rounded, slightly forward-leaning Japanese RPG lettering style: pale warm ivory fill, crisp thick dark plum/burgundy outline, subtle pink inner rim. Transparent background with real alpha, no frame, no plaque, no rectangle, no checkerboard baked into pixels. Center the word on a wide 4.5:1 transparent canvas, keeping generous left/right transparent padding and modest top/bottom padding like the original 144x32 sprite. Letters must remain very readable when reduced to about 20px high. Redraw polished English lettering, no Japanese remnants. The entire word should occupy roughly 65% of the canvas width (short names may be narrower), and 65% of its height. Preserve a flat sprite style, no photorealism, no glow outside the plum outline.
images.output_hint:
Generated images are saved to C:\Users\Binh\.codex\generated_images\01a0db63-acc7-7ff0-b061-538dd1602405 as C:\Users\Binh\.codex\generated_images\01a0db63-acc7-7ff0-b061-538dd1602405\exec-fbf72d17-542c-45bb-bc61-65fa8fcba429.png by default.
If you need to use a generated image at another path, copy it and leave the original in place unless the user explicitly asks you to delete it.
The generated image is already displayed to the user. There is no need to render it in the final response as a Markdown image or file link.
